verified_rules: registered title boundaries are general boundaries unless recorded as determined
a general boundary does not identify the exact legal line
a determined boundary records that an exact line has been identified but the legislation does not define exact
HM Land Registry does not resolve the underlying boundary disagreement through determination
a filed determined-boundary plan is retained and is required to identify the exact line
title-plan red edging ordinarily shows only the general position of boundaries
title-plan scale reproduction and line thickness prevent unsupported survey-grade coordinate extraction
general-boundary and determined-boundary guidance was updated on 1 June 2026
public INSPIRE polygon extents must not be promoted to an exact legal boundary without matching current identity and supporting records
candidate-specific current INSPIRE IDs polygon bytes and determined-plan evidence remain necessary for binding
quality_gate: PASS for boundary-law and plan-precision contracts; BLOCKED for exact candidate boundary binding
